label: D1 after a rare a1->S2 transition, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation, outcome shown; never at GO or D2). On D1 it fires when the previous trial was a rare transition after choosing a1 (a1 led to S2): prev_common==0 holds 78% of activation mass, prev_action==1 holds 78%, and after a2 it almost never fires (4% of mass). It fires whether that rare trial was rewarded or not; adding prev_reward==0 makes F1 worse (0.49). It is also confined to the first ~40 trials of an episode: rate is 5x baseline in trials 0-9, falls steadily, and is zero after trial 50. The ep_trial<35 cutoff raises precision from 0.21 to 0.63. Every variable is observed at D1, so no future variables are used. Misses (~23% of mass) are mostly on the window first trial, where prev_action is unknown, plus scattered weak activations after other histories. Value and policy-logit bins did not improve the predicate. Dev F1 is 0.67 and mass recall 0.76, so the feature is only partly explained: within the predicate it fires on about 63% of steps, and we did not find what gates the rest besides episode time.
